rationale: Y has a more specific, characterful hero (azulejo tiles, window light, EXIF caption), per-feature illustrations, a blue metrics band and a real enquiry form, all in a warm Lisbon-flavoured palette. X is refined in type but its feature cards use small icons only, the hero illustration is generic, and the long page reads as a standard section stack. Y is the one a design director would ship; X is the more template-like.
